We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. - Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

- Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

- Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

- Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb's Online Data organization runs the stores behind every booking, every message, and every payment. Storage Foundation owns the engines underneath those stores. We build and operate Airbnb's source of truth databases for the company's online OLTP traffic, and we own the control plane that provisions, upgrades, and heals them. This is engine work, not fleet administration. When our engines are slow, unavailable, or wrong, so is the product.

As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead engineers across multiple teams and you will manage managers. You will own the engine strategy, the reliability commitment that every service above you depends on, and the growth of the people who do the work. Your leverage comes from the managers and technical leads on your teams, the bar you hold in design and incident reviews, and the trust you build with the teams who stake their product on us.

The Difference You Will Make:

Set the technical direction for Airbnb's online storage engines

You will set a multi-year technical vision for the engines and the control plane beneath every transactional and key value store at Airbnb, and you will make the calls that follow from it. That includes where we invest in our own engine expertise, where we buy instead of build, how we evaluate alternative engines against real production traffic, and which capabilities have to exist before a workload can safely land on us. You will also make the cost of these systems measurable and attributable, so that investment decisions rest on evidence. You will make these calls alongside senior technical leaders across Online Data and the broader Infrastructure organization.

Make reliability the ground truth of the platform

The services built on your engines commit to availability targets that only hold if the engine underneath them is better than they are. You will own that engine level commitment and the error budgets that feed every product surface above it. You will drive fault isolation so that one tenant cannot degrade everyone else, prove regional failover with scheduled production drills, and treat capacity headroom as a reliability decision. You will own incidents in your area personally, and you will turn each one into a structural fix.

Make routine work disappear

Every ticket is a product team waiting on us and an engineer pulled off platform work. You will push your teams to build API first, so that provisioning, schema changes, grants, and quotas can be driven by an engineer, a tool, or an agent without a human in the loop. You will use AI where it takes real work off your teams.

Build and grow the team

You will coach engineering managers and senior technical leads, and grow the depth of database expertise inside Airbnb. That means taking a forward view of talent needs, building a succession pipeline, hiring senior engineers who can own a complex open source codebase, and creating the conditions where people do the most technically ambitious work of their careers. You will also represent this group to executive leadership and to our customers, and you will make the case for investment in terms the business can act on.

title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
description:
Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable

Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform.

About the Team

The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.

You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it.

The Challenge

Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering:

• Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure.

• Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets.

• Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones.

Our culture is grounded in collaboration, empathy, and a data-driven mindset. We thrive on curiosity, proactive problem-solving, and a strong desire to learn, improve, and stay ahead in a fast-evolving digital environment.

This role is central to ensuring that marketing initiatives are executed seamlessly across multiple platforms. You will manage timelines, coordinate teams, and track campaign progress to ensure high-quality, on-time delivery.
This role is ideal for someone who is organized, resourceful, and confident in managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Project Coordination

• Coordinate and manage marketing projects in Asana, ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.

• Maintain and update the marketing calendar and promotional schedules.

Campaign Execution

• Support the execution of digital marketing campaigns (email, social media, SEO, website updates, and more).

• Collaborate closely with designers, writers, and developers to move projects forward efficiently.

• Assist with content creation (social media posts, email drafts, landing pages, etc.) and quality control.

Performance Monitoring

• Track campaign performance metrics and prepare reports and insights for leadership.

• Monitor project progress, flag risks, and adjust timelines as needed.

Continuous Improvement

• Stay current with marketing best practices and propose new ideas for optimization.

What We Are Looking For

• Strong organizational and project management skills with experience using Asana.

• Understanding of marketing campaigns, digital channels, and content creation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities with a high degree of attention to detail.

• Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fully remote environment.

What You Bring

• 3 to 5 years of experience in marketing coordination, project management, or a similar role.

• Proven ability to keep projects on track and meet deadlines.

• Familiarity with email marketing platforms like Mailchimp, HubSpot, or similar.

• Basic knowledge of Canva, WordPress, or graphic design tools.

• Experience in healthcare or eye care is a plus.

Work Requirements

• 100 percent remote work-from-home

• Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

• Reliable high-speed internet

• Quiet, professional workspace

We prioritize clear communication, good judgment, and steady execution. You will be trusted to manage your projects without micromanagement. That means asking smart questions early, owning your decisions, and showing up with care and clarity.
